{{Quote|In the market for a new droid? Perhaps you're more interested in some upgrades? I have everything you need!|80-T5|<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>}}
'''80-T5''' was a [[GL-916's model/Legends|vendor droid]] found in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The droid sold [[Droid/Legends|droids]].
